headline: Southern New Hampshire finish top of the conference table
dek: Southern New Hampshire finished the conference schedule on twenty points, three clear of American International and four clear of Bentley. Franklin Pierce's win over Assumption closed the round with every member on nine matches; Saint Michael's and Pace share the foot of the table on four points.
displaced_by: Franklin Pierce v Assumption was played, so every member has now played all nine of its conference matches and the standing dek's 'two matches between members remain' is no longer true

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Southern New Hampshire's fifty-two goals come from at least sixteen different scorers, so the tallest bar is the work of a squad rather than a single forward.

wire.line: Southern New Hampshire have scored fifty-two goals and conceded ten this season.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Guillermo Rios has scored sixteen of Franklin Pierce's thirty-two goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Saint Michael's have lost ten matches, more than any other programme.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Southern Connecticut have drawn seven matches, more than any other programme.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Saint Anselm have won eight matches and lost seven, and remain the only programme yet to draw a match.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Javier Solá Martínez has kept seven clean sheets in goal for American International.

last_match.line: Franklin Pierce's win, the last match the table counts, draws them level on points with Saint Anselm.

next_match.line: Bentley won the conference meeting between the two in September; Assumption arrive off defeat at Franklin Pierce.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
